ConfigResponse.description:
Response for GET /config — the full reference bundle for a signed-in frontend (adds the
lifecycle/role enums the dashboard needs to render tables and filters). Localized per the user's
resolved language.

topup_methods.description: Balance top-up methods the configured terminal supports (for the payment picker).

LabelItem.description: A selectable value with its localized display label.

label.description: Display label in the resolved language.

MetaResponse.description:
Response for GET /meta — public reference data needed before sign-in (e.g. registration
forms). Labels are localized via Accept-Language (spec §1.6).

docs.description: Where the docs live; the frontend fetches the link map from LinksUrl.

device_registered.description: Whether the device is now registered.

android_version.description: Reported Android API level, if any.

RegisterSimRequest.description: A SIM entry in a registration request.

verification_found.description: Whether the report matched a pending session.

request_id.description: The matched session's id, if any.

caller_number.description: End user who placed the call.

receiver_number.description: The gateway SIM number that was dialed — the matching key.

CheckCodeResponse.description: Success response for a code check.

phone_number.description: The verified number, normalised to E.164.

request_id.description: The session id to check against.

code.description: The code submitted by the integrator.

success_rate.description: Successful divided by total, rounded to 4 places.

total_cost.description: Total amount charged across the range.

by_status.description:
Verification counts grouped by status — the failure breakdown (expired vs
failed) integrators use to diagnose drop-off.

daily.description:
Per-day counts across the range, ordered by date — for trend charts. Days with no activity
are omitted.

UsageDayResponse.description: One day's counts in a usage report.

phone_number.description: The verified number, normalised to E.164.

verified_at.description: When verification succeeded (UTC), if it did.

number_to_call.description: Gateway SIM number to display: "Call this number".

InitiateVerificationResponse.description: Response for POST /v1/verify, common fields shared by every method.

phone_number.description: The verified number, normalised to E.164.

expires_at.description: When the session expires (UTC) if not verified.

code_length.description: Number of digits in the code the user will receive and must enter.

TopupResponse.description:
A balance top-up (spec §11; payments-tbank-design). Returned by create, list and detail. Nullable
fields fill in as it progresses: payment_url while pending, settled_amount/paid_at
on success.

customer_email.description: Customer email captured at payment time (used for refunds).

payment_url.description: Where to send the payer: redirect (card) or open / QR-encode (SBP). Null once terminal.

CreateTopupRequest.description:
Body for POST /dashboard/topups — request a balance top-up (spec §11; payments-tbank-design).
Currency is the account's, not supplied here.

amount.description: Amount to top up, in the account's currency.

method.description: Payment method (must be one the terminal supports, see /config).

email.description: Required. Email the payment receipt is sent to (the SPA defaults it to the user's email).

PagedResponseOfVerificationListItemRespo.description: A page of results plus its pagination metadata.

VerificationListItemResponse.description:
A verification session row in a list response. Carries only the masked number — the raw
number is never stored or returned (spec §7).

RsqlListRequest.description: Query parameters for an RSQL list endpoint: filtering, sorting and pagination.

MeResponse.description: Response for GET /me — the signed-in user's identity + settings (spec §9).

account.description: The owned account summary, if any.

AccountSummaryResponse.description: Minimal account view returned with auth tokens.

currency.description: Emitted as the verbatim ISO-4217 code (e.g. RUB).

PagedResponseOfTopupResponse.description: A page of results plus its pagination metadata.

PagedResponseOfLedgerEntryResponse.description: A page of results plus its pagination metadata.

SetLocaleRequest.description: Body for POST /dashboard/locale — set the user's preferred response language (spec §1.6).

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Body for POST /auth/password/change — change password knowing the current one.

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Body for POST /auth/password/forgot — request a reset code.

AuthResponse.description:
Token response for register/login/refresh (spec §7). Both tokens are returned in the body;
the client stores and sends them (JWT-only — no cookies).

preferred_currency.description: ISO-4217 code; v1 accepts only RUB.

locale.description: Preferred response language (en/ru); defaults to en.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Body for POST /auth/password/reset — set a new password with the emailed code.

CreditAccountRequest.description: Body + route for POST /admin/accounts/{id}/credit (manual balance credit).

amount.description: Positive amount to credit, in the account's currency.

AccountDetailResponse.description:
Full account profile for the admin client drill-down (GET /admin/accounts/{id}). The api
secret is never returned; api_key is shown for admin support.

AdminStatsResponse.description:
Daily platform analytics. The frontend derives the headline numbers (today / month / rates) from
days; current carries the point-in-time counts that aren't daily-derivable.

currency.description: Currency of the per-day cost (verbatim ISO-4217, e.g. RUB).

AdminStatsRequest.description: Query for GET /admin/stats/daily — a date range (defaults to the last 30 days).

AdminGatewaysResponse.description: Gateway fleet + SIM-pool health (admin, spec Appendix A / admin-api-design §5).

number_masked.description: Masked SIM number for display (decrypted then masked), or null if undecryptable.

live_load.description: Verifications currently awaiting a call on this SIM (live load).

balance_usd.description: Last reported Gateway balance in USD, or null if we've never sent.

as_of.description: When that balance was observed (the send that reported it).

low_balance.description: True when the balance is below the configured threshold.

min_balance_usd.description: The configured low-balance threshold (USD), if any.

allOf.description: Full user profile for the admin drill-down (GET /admin/users/{id}).

UserAccountSummary.description: Minimal owned-account view inside a user detail.

UserListItemResponse.description: A user row in the admin user list (GET /admin/users, spec §10).

PagedResponseOfAccountListItemResponse.description: A page of results plus its pagination metadata.

AccountListItemResponse.description: A registration row in the admin listing (GET /admin/accounts, spec §10).

PriceItemResponse.description: A price-book row in admin listings.

PagedResponseOfUserListItemResponse.description: A page of results plus its pagination metadata.

SetPriceRequest.description:
Body for POST /admin/prices (spec §11.0). Method/currency accepted as wire codes
(e.g. reverse_flash_call, RUB), parsed case-insensitively.

effective_from.description: When the price takes effect; defaults to now.

JWTBearerAuth.description: Enter a JWT token to authorize the requests...
